notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
1. Fix Voice misplacement problem.
2. Fix story bug of Ciou Yu Chuan.
3. Save&Load system slot expansion, marking the story line in slot, adding an automatic save field.
4. Gift-giving responses vary by gift.
5. Fixed the issue that UI language settings would not be saved.

1.語音錯置問題
2.秋雨泉線邏輯問題
3.存檔擴充、標示攻略中路線、增加自動存檔欄位
4.送禮會根據禮物而有不同反應了
5.修復UI語言的設置不會被儲存的問題

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Log, Save, Config can be right-clicked to leave.
The achievement calculation method for taking the MRT and taxi has been changed to the total number of games.

Log, Save, Config 可以右鍵離開
搭捷運、計程車成就計算方式變更為全遊戲次數
